newsitem.title: TURKEY: Kurdish rebels release five abducted villagers.
newsitem.headline: Kurdish rebels release five abducted villagers.

text.p: Kurdish rebels in the southeast of Turkey have released five villagers from a group of eight they abducted two weeks ago, a security force official said on Monday.
Two of the group were still being held by guerrillas of the separatist Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK), the official said.
Another member of the group, Hasan Lalealp who belonged to an anti-rebel village guard militia, was found shot dead on waste ground in Diyarbakir province last Thursday.
More than 22,000 people have died in the 12-year conflict between the Turkish security forces and the PKK rebels, who are fighting for autonomy or independence in the mainly Kurdish southeast.
